payload.claim: Every fixture in this file (the `_tests` helper) sets `Failure(file=n, code=n, ...)`, i.e. `code` is always the test's own node id — the fallback-path shape of the real `tests` gate, never its common regex-parsed shape (exception-type `code`, as in `test_criteria.py`'s `keyed_elsewhere` fixture). The suite is therefore only correct for the one shape of runner output it happens to construct, which is why the missing guard at revert.py:123-125 passed every gate here.
